items.title: A new profile and sidebar to manage your account
items.summary: Edit your details, photo, and verified phone number in a redesigned profile, with a refreshed sidebar that collapses to save space. You can also review the latest features you've missed since your last login from your profile.

items.title: Show off progress at the halfway mark
items.summary: Once a project reaches 50% complete and has a good photo from a published weekly update, Revive offers a 50% completion marketing image. Share it to give clients a timely look at your work in progress.

items.title: Your projects now market themselves
items.summary: When a project breaks ground, Revive turns its photos into branded marketing pieces with your name on them. Show clients your work and stay top of mind without opening a design tool.

items.title: Look polished on every piece you share
items.summary: Add your photo, brokerage logo, and contact details once, and Revive brands your Marketing Center materials as you. Update your profile anytime and refresh your materials to match.

items.title: Sign in with just your phone number
items.summary: Getting into Revive now starts with your phone number, so there's one less password to remember. Have more than one account? Pick the one you want and you're in.

items.title: See your whole renovation in one place
items.summary: Every project now has its own page with progress, photos, scope, team, and contracts side by side. Revive also highlights what changed since your last visit, so you never miss an update.

items.title: Project documents arrive with your weekly update
items.summary: Weekly updates now bring documents along with the photos. Open or download them right from the update instead of hunting for them somewhere else.

items.title: Go from Revive AI report to project in fewer steps
items.summary: Start a project from any Revive AI report and Revive fills in the property details and photos it already has. Skip the repeat questions and get your project moving sooner.
